d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.summary: flush() can return false on queue-offer failure or timeout; DuoApp ignores the Boolean and proceeds to create/share/upload; exporter has no flush/drop/completeness marker; uploader receipt SHA validates ZIP bytes only.

en: Peer review corroborates the Alpha3 diagnostic-export integrity finding by independent current-main call-flow inspection. The flush result is ignored, no completeness marker is exported, and the receipt hash only authenticates the resulting ZIP bytes.
